rules: Every printed part retains stock, job, CAD and inspection ancestry. Unknown part partition is resolved by a finite qualified manifest, not a count guess.
A panel binds each design position 1 through 30 exactly once, following row min(position,31-position).
Changing a part, join or geometry increments panel revision and invalidates panel inspection until repeated.
Changing source, reference pose, grid or signal chain invalidates matched-pair status; requalify and reacquire affected conditions.
Reference and scan microphones are distinct physical objects and never exchange roles by relabeling.
Ten readouts at one point are technical readouts, not ten independent specimens or campaigns.
Failed and superseded readouts remain immutable; a retry has a new attempt identity and explicitly supersedes an invalid attempt in the same point and slot.
Interpolated fields and paper reference values have no raw-acquisition ancestry and cannot satisfy readout counts.
Condition order is an authored scheduling choice; no historical order or independent replicate count is recovered.
replacement: Quarantine damaged components; replacement creates a new component ID and panel revision. No deletion of prior attempts or resurrection by relabeling.
